what: PAIRS-ALPACA-BUILD residual (INFERRED from code, not observed): alpaca_paper nets per symbol and also rosters gld_pullback_1d (GLD) and gdx_pullback_1d (GDX). The new pairs path refuses to OPEN onto a directional GLD/GDX row (skip_directional_conflict), but the reverse is not guarded by the pairs code: while pairs_gld_gdx holds a leg, the coordinator's net-position read (src/runtime/positions.py::current_net_position_qty sums ALL open rows on account+symbol, pairs rows included) makes a directional GLD/GDX package read the pairs leg as existing exposure -- intent-mode: an opposite package is refused and a same-side one may be sized as a delta/noop; legacy mode: the binary open-position block refuses it. If neither happens and an order is sent, Alpaca would net it against the pairs leg. Decide: exclude pairs rows from the directional net read on session venues, or accept the blocked directional entries as the soak's cost.
